title: Refined: layered, soft, Apple-inspired
question: Reset around your steer: Apple's guidelines as the reference (depth, translucency, restraint), no flat colour fields. Pick one.

options.label: Frosted Gallery
options.lineage: Apple Photos and Finder: translucent chrome over content
options.thesis: Frosted sidebar, toolbar and sheets float over the images, which are the only real colour.
options.viewport: Translucent sidebar, floating toolbar, rounded cards with soft depth, detail as a floating sheet.
options.risk: Blur over busy images costs paint time; needs a solid fallback.

raised.raise: Each list keeps a hue, now a small gradient tile in the sidebar instead of a flat field.

options.label: Paper & Sunlight
options.lineage: Apple Books and Notes, warm and tactile
options.thesis: A warm, paper-like stack of sheets with gentle depth and a single burnt-orange action colour.
options.viewport: Warm translucent shell over a sunlit gradient, white sheet cards, orange only on actions.
options.risk: Warm neutrals with a rust accent is a familiar lane.

options.label: Night Studio
options.lineage: Apple TV and Photos in dark
options.thesis: Dark graphite where images glow and floating controls stay quiet.
options.viewport: Graphite shell with luminous cards and a periwinkle accent.
options.risk: Light mode is a separate full design to maintain.

options.label: Ambient Tint
options.lineage: Apple Music and Podcasts, colour from the content
options.thesis: The open list bleeds a soft tint into the background glow; the chrome stays neutral glass.
options.viewport: Same glass shell, a teal glow behind it for Movies and a different hue per list.
options.risk: Per-list tints need contrast checks; must stay subtle.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean white collection app: sidebar, card grid, detail panel, one blue accent.
canonCard.viewport: White shell, blue primary buttons, neutral cards.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
